diagram_math_checks.data: Complex plane, circle gamma(t)=1+(1/2)e^{it}, spectral set {1,2}, E={1}.
diagram_math_checks.checks: Both axes use equal 2cm units. The drawn circle has center (1,0) and radius 0.5. Point 1 is at its center; point 2 has distance 1 from the center, outside the radius 0.5. Thus the trace avoids both spectral points, as step 1.1 states. The arrow follows the arc from angle 0 to 65 degrees, counterclockwise, matching increasing t in the Given contour and the positive winding used in step 2.1.

Step 2.1 computes P_E=diag(1,0), so multiplication on the standard basis gives exactly the two rightward arrows. Both arrows depict vector images in C^2, rather than maps between spectral points. Step 3.1 proves ran(P_E)=C e1 and ker(P_E)=C e2 and the T-restrictions by 1 and 2, which are the two figure labels and accompanying prose. No other relation or commutativity is asserted.
